D10·5f40 — 2026-10-10
chose: The verify slot is per user per machine: a flock-semantics lock on <state base>/verify.lock, on the run lock's primitive, polled so stop requests are still read. The wait is bounded by the command's own timeout, after which the command runs without the slot and a warning says so
over: A per-repo slot under the git common dir; an in-process semaphore in the coordinator; an unbounded blocking wait
because: Load is a property of the machine: drives of other initiatives and other repos verify on the same box, and lanes of one coordinator contend on the lock too, since flock is per open file description. The kernel releases the lock however its holder dies, as it does for the run lock. An unattended run must have no state it can sit in forever, and the holder's command is bounded by its own timeout.
